allowAccessToFileURLsMessage.description: Request for allowing access to file URLs
allowAccessToFileURLsMessage.message: Please allow access to file URLs in the following screen and then reload current page

appDesc.description: The description of the application, displayed in the web store.
appDesc.message: Translate text on PDF/HTML/TXT in two clicks, even for local docs. Now with ChatGPT support.

appName.description: The title of the application, displayed in the web store.

author.description: The author of the application, displayed in the web store.

cspPronounceDesc.description: Description to inform users about enabling pronunciation on pages protected by Content Security Policy, with examples of compatible websites.
cspPronounceDesc.message: Enables pronunciation on Content Security Policy (CSP) protected pages, such as github.com, apple.com, binance.com, etc., where this feature is possible.

cspPronounceName.description: Name of the setting for enabling pronunciation on CSP protected pages.

defineButton.description: Button text for the define action in popup window

errorMessage.description: Generic error message displayed when something goes wrong

fallbackFileAccessRequiredHeading.description: Heading shown when file access permission is needed for local files

fallbackFileAccessRequiredMessage.description: Message explaining how to enable file access permissions for local files
fallbackFileAccessRequiredMessage.message:
To translate text in local files, you need to grant permissions to this extension.

Please enable "Allow access to file URLs" on the extension settings page, then reload this file. For immediate translation, you can also use the right-click context menu or copy and paste text into this window.

fallbackFileReloadHeading.description: Heading shown when content script is missing in a local file with proper permissions

fallbackFileReloadMessage.description: Message explaining how to reload a local file to enable extension features
fallbackFileReloadMessage.message:
The content script is not ready yet. This can happen after an update or if the file was opened before the extension was enabled.

Please reload this file to use all features. For immediate translation, you can also use the right-click context menu or copy and paste text into this window.

fallbackPageReloadHeading.description: Heading shown when content script is missing on a web page

fallbackPageReloadMessage.description: Message explaining how to reload a web page to enable extension features
fallbackPageReloadMessage.message:
The content script is not ready yet. This usually happens after installing or updating the extension.

Please reload this page to use all features. For immediate translation, you can also use the right-click context menu or copy and paste text into this window.

inaccessiblePageHeading.description: Heading shown when the extension cannot access the current page

inaccessiblePageMessage.description: Message for pages that are fundamentally non-injectable (Chrome store, internal pages) without reload suggestion
inaccessiblePageMessage.message: The extension cannot access this page due to browser security restrictions. Please paste text into the field above or try the right-click context menu for instant definitions.

loginToChatGPT.description: Link text prompting user to log into ChatGPT when authorization fails

noDefinitionFound.description: Message displayed when no definition is available and ChatGPT backup is disabled

noSelectionHeading.description: Heading for when no text is selected or selection is not accessible

noSelectionMessagePopup.description: Message for the popup window when no selection is found. Includes reference to the input field.
noSelectionMessagePopup.message: Could not retrieve a selection. If text is selected, the keyboard shortcut may be blocked on this page. Please paste the text into the input field above or try the right-click context menu.

noSelectionMessageQtip.description: Message for qTip when no selection is found. Omits reference to popup input field.
noSelectionMessageQtip.message: Could not retrieve a selection. If text is selected, the keyboard shortcut may be blocked on this page. You can also try the right-click context menu.

notificationButtonAllow.description: Button text for allowing action in notification

notificationButtonReload.description: Button text for reloading page in notification

notificationGenericFailureMessage.description: Message for a generic, unexpected failure in a notification
notificationGenericFailureMessage.message: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.

nowrapDesc.description: Description of the option to remove line breaks in the selected text before translation
nowrapDesc.message: Activate this option to remove line breaks in the text selected for translation, particularly enhancing the quality of translations for PDF files with columns or intricate layouts.

nowrapName.description: Option name for removing line breaks in the text selected for translation

openKeyboardShortcutsTitle.description: Title of the keyboard shortcuts link
openKeyboardShortcutsTitle.message: Keyboard Shortcuts for Extensions and Apps

pageInaccessibleMessage.description: Message when page cannot be accessed for translation
pageInaccessibleMessage.message: This page is not accessible for translation

processing.description: Status message shown while the extension is processing a request

reloadPageMessage.description: Generic request to reload the page to activate the extension's content script.
reloadPageMessage.message: The extension isn't active yet. Please reload the page to enable all features.

searchWebDesc.description: Description of the 'Search the web' functionality
searchWebDesc.message: Adds a 'Search the web' link in the bottom right corner of the popup, allowing you to search the web with selected text using Google or Bing.

searchWebName.description: Name of the link to search the web with selected text

selectionIconDesc.description: Description of the Selection Icon feature
selectionIconDesc.message: When enabled, a small icon will appear when you select text, allowing you to quickly translate it. (Note: Does not work on PDF files or protected pages like Chrome Web Store)

selectionIconName.description: Name of the setting to show an icon when text is selected

short_name.description: The short name of the application, displayed in the web store.

shortcut.description: Keyboard shortcut for translation on the fly

thinkingText.description: Status message shown while ChatGPT is processing a request

useCGBDesc.description: Description of the ChatGPT as backup option with accessibility info
useCGBDesc.message: Allows you to use ChatGPT as a backup definition provider when the primary provider fails or can't find a definition. May not be accessible from all areas.

useCGBName.description: Toggle to use ChatGPT as a backup translation provider
